notes: 2026-10-08 review fail by reviewer: Acceptance 1-8 are all present in the text and the 3 diagrams pass mapgrain validate. (2) The same Guard blocks calls to the Delay module (queue and the cancel path target the Delay contract), and it lets owners call refund/recover directly on receivers, so the 24-48 h delay is not enforced. Safe 1.4.1 Guards do not check module transactions. Fix: Guard allows self-calls (or a named allowlist of Safe admin selectors) and the Delay module; it rejects direct refund/recover/settle-after-deadline selectors so they only run through the Delay; setPaused and setExecutor stay direct. (3) contracts-workflow refund and recover nodes say 'the same Safe transaction calls Factory.deploy first'; that needs MultiSend, which is a delegatecall the Guard blocks. Say two transactions, or allow MultiSendCallOnly by address.
